name: change-desk
description: An approval room where AI agents and team owners decide if an API change is safe to ship

scripts.pipeline: tsx tools/detect.ts demo/api-service/openapi.v1.yaml demo/api-service/openapi.v2.yaml --out changes.json && tsx tools/usage-scan.ts changes.json service-map.yaml --out findings.json && tsx tools/cost.ts findings.json service-map.yaml --out cost.json
